units: <cite ref="Eruvin 3a">Erub. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>אמרינן קְלוֹשׁ</he> we say, plane it, i.e. consider it reduced to a fine film.
<cite ref="Eruvin 3a:18">Ib.</cite> <he>אי קַלְשַׁה</he> if thou makest it very thin.
Ned. 68ᵃ מִיקְלַשׁ קָלֵישׁ does he plane (weaken) it?, v. גּוּז ch.—Part. pass. קָלִישׁ, קְלִישָׁא; f. קְלִישָׁא, קְלִישְׁתָּא thin, weak.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 7:13">Targ. Y. Num. VII, 13</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="S01352"><he>קַלִּישָׁא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 7:19">ib. 19</cite> (opp. <he>סמיך</he>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Taanit 9b:6">Taan. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>עיבא ק׳</he> a light cloud, opp. <cite ref="O01094"><he>סמיכתא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Sotah 34b:13">Sot. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>איידי דק׳ ארעא</he> because the layer of earth (over the rocky soil) is very light.

<cite ref="Yevamot 113a:18">Yeb. 113ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>דעתא ק׳ וכ׳</he> his reason is weak, but it is doubtful whether it is equally clear &c., v. <cite ref="R00354"><he>צִילָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 113b">ib. 113ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Sukkah 48b:10">Succ. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>חמרא סמיך מיא ק׳</he> wine is thick (does nor run out quickly), water is thin.

senses.gloss: to make thin, cover with a thin layer.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 2:5">ib. II, 5</cite>) means covering lightly, opp. <he>אסמוכי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 21:15">Targ. Y. Gen. XXI, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 33:25">Targ. Job XXXIII, 25</cite> Regia (ed. <he>אתחליש</he>).
